context: A married couple reflects on the past year at home
purpose: Teach: あがっ/だす/云う/反面/誇る/著しく/僅か/満たす

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 今年は本当に色々あったな。振り返ると、家族の収入も僅かだが上がった気がするよ。
lines.en: So much happened this year. Looking back, our family income went up slightly, I think.
lines.style: Warm reflective tone, husband speaking softly at the kotatsu in plain form

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうね、給料があがったのは嬉しい反面、あなたの残業時間も著しく増えちゃったじゃない。
lines.en: Yes, the raise was nice, but on the other hand your overtime hours have noticeably gone up too, haven't they?
lines.style: Gentle wifely concern with slight teasing affection, casual feminine sentence endings at home

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 云うまでもないけど、君のおかげで何とかやってこられたんだ。本当に感謝してるよ。
lines.en: It goes without saying, but I got through it thanks to you. I'm truly grateful.
lines.style: Sincere husband expressing heartfelt gratitude in a calm soft kotatsu voice

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 急に何よ。でも、ハナコが歩きだすのを一緒に見られて、私も本当に幸せだったわ。
lines.en: What's gotten into you suddenly? But getting to see Hanako start walking together made me really happy too.
lines.style: Slightly embarrassed laugh then tender maternal warmth with soft feminine speech

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: あの子の成長は親として誇るしかないよ。まあ、ちょっと親バカかもしれないけどね。
lines.en: As a parent, I can only be proud of how that kid is growing. Well, maybe I'm a bit of a doting dad though.
lines.style: Proud father chuckling with self-aware joking tone and relaxed conversational warmth

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、間違いないわ。来年も小さな幸せを一つずつ満たすような一年にしたいわね。
lines.en: Hehe, no doubt about it. Next year too, I'd like it to be a year where we fill it up with little joys one by one.
lines.style: Soft laugh and hopeful wife looking toward the future with warm feminine intonation

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: そうだな。来年こそ、二人でゆっくり温泉旅行にでも行こうか。
lines.en: You're right. Next year for sure, shall we go on a relaxing hot spring trip, just the two of us?
lines.style: Tender husband proposal with calm inviting tone and plain form sentence-final question
